findings.explanation: high confidence.  Witness: The true probability that no vertex in A_{i+1} precedes A_i^r - {w} is at least |A_i^r - {w}| / (|A_i^r - {w}| + |A_{i+1}|) = \Omega(1 / \log n), not exponentially small in |A_{i+1}| / |A_i^r| as claimed by assuming independence across vertices in A_{i+1} in (1 - 1/(2|A_i^r|))^{|A_{i+1}|} <= n^{-7} in [p12-9]. Thus, Lemma 4.5 fails under union bound over n vertices and t iterations since the failure probability is \Omega(1 / \log n). Under any correct calculation, with |A_{i+1}| \approx 25 \log(n) |A_i^r|, the probability of failure is \Theta(1 / \log n). Therefore, the union bound cannot hold with high probability 1 - 1/n^2 across all vertices u in V, iterations r, and levels i without significant modifications to the parameters (e.g. increasing the sample size t to poly(n)). Indeed, the events that different vertices v in A_{i+1} precede the fixed set A_i^r - {w} are conditioned on the same random set A_i^r - {w} and are positively correlated (they all occur if the minimum of A_i^r - {w} appears late in the ordering), so independence does not hold and the failure probability does not multiply as (1 - p)^{|A_{i+1}|}.
